newsitem.title: USA: Dow falls 70 points, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow falls 70 points, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks pushed lower in late afternoon activity, with the Dow slumping more than 70 points.
The decline triggered index-arbitrage program trading curbs on the New York Stock Exchange at 1501 EST/2001 GMT.

The most recent dip in stocks was tied to a sell program, the first program activity of the day, according to Birinyi Associates. The market impact could not yet be calculated, the firm said, because the program was still underway.
At 1515 EST/2015 GMT the Dow stood at 6478, down nearly 72 points and barely above its session low of 6474.
